summary: Cache directory and files must use 0o700/0o600 and must chmod existing entries so upgrades from pre-fix installs also tighten legacy 0o644 files.
reason: SendFox API responses under /contacts and /campaigns include PII and full email body HTML. The generated writeCache used 0o755/0o644. MkdirAll and WriteFile do not change permissions on pre-existing entries, so an explicit Chmod after each call is required to cover upgrade paths.
